changeinfo.changes: - A new playable character is added. - Stability has been enhanced.

- The gallery can be viewed at the inn.
- Facilities for changing party's equipment are added to the weapon shop and the tavern.
- Settings for fixing the rotations for the mini-map are added to OPTIONS.
- Now on the Title screen you can choose to play the main story from the beginning.
- Sub-scenarios are added.
- Extra Quests and Multiplayer Quests are added.
- New playable characters, Sword Skills, emotes and HG weapons are added.
- DLC costumes—Swimsuits and the GGO Avatars—are now released.
- PvP fights are added.
- Special effects for the weapons are added, and effect ranks are adjusted.
- Memory functions for the cursor position are enabled at some screens.
- Party members can be changed with the right stick at the status, equipment and the skill screens.
The aforementioned menu screens can also be switched with the SELECT button now.
- Equipment can now be changed on the field. ※This cannot be done during multiplayer mode.
- A list of special effects can now be shown by pressing the □ button at the weapon details screen.
- Weapon details can be opened at the screens for the weapon identification result and for weapon enhancement.
- Items can now be sold all at once when selling the items that you own.
- The function for changing the order of consumables is added to the Main Menu.
- Explanations after enhancement are added to the explanation windows for Sword Skills and Magic Skills in the skill change UI.
- Requirements for Participating Members can now be set for Multiplayer Quests.
- Multiplayer quest party leaders can remove participating members from the Quest Board.
- Stability has been enhanced.
- Game balance has been adjusted.

- The Cross-Save feature has been implemented.
